formal_results: The prescribed uniform-even-parity triple law is normalized and nonnegative.
All pair projections are independent uniform distributions.
No nonnegative rational four-bit law realizes all four prescribed triple laws.
Any finite-seed common four-bit output induces a global nonnegative rational law; consequently no such simulator realizes the local laws.
A context-aware two-fair-bit simulator realizes every requested triple law exactly.
The all-zero assignment is in every local support; the obstruction uses nonnegative probabilities, not absence of any global support assignment.
